description: This Java class 'InstallmentLevelDelinquency' models data related to delinquency classifications at the installment level within the loan portfolio module. It contains fields for range ID, classification, age days, and delinquent amount, and includes a static factory method to create instances from 'LoanInstallmentDelinquencyTagData'.

classes.name: InstallmentLevelDelinquency
classes.description: A data class representing the delinquency status for a specific loan installment, including classification, age range, and amount.
